notes.title: Scrap Seas Major Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello Sailors!

We are so happy to announce that Scrap Seas will be participating in Steam's Plane's Trains' and Automobiles event!

[h1]NEW BUILD![/h1]
[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1535810/extras/robotRammingSkirmish-ezgif.com-optimize.gif?t=1725203256[/img]
To celebrate we are publishing our most current build of the Scrap Seas Demo to Steam for free!  This version of the demo we would previously only share with publishers or at select conventions will now be open to the public starting [b]September 16th (next Monday). [/b] 

This version has [b]WAY more features[/b] than the demo up right now.  Features include, but are not limited to:
[list]
[*] A new overworld map where you can plot your course and choose what battles to fight!
[*] Dialogue encounters that introduce some story elements to Scrap Seas and will allow you to shape the kinds of battles you enter
[*] Ship Pilots that will talk to you as you are exploding their ship (or they are exploding yours...)
[*] Overall UI improvements
[/list]
[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1535810/extras/overworldTokenMovement.gif?t=1725203256[/img]

If you have already played our old demo, its definitely worth checking out this update.  It's an entirely new experience. Please be sure to tell your friends and wishlist!

[h1]CONTEST[/h1]
To celebrate we are running a promotion/contest.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/8ccde3d33070b1c385280c3ad8b778ba4f486f8d.png[/img]
We have 5 Pete The Placeholder Duck enamel pins that we will mail to the [b]first 5 people[/b] to post a video of themselves successfully completing a run on [b]HARD MODE[/b] on the new build.  
 [list]
[*] The video must include the beginning to the end of the run
[*] The run must be completed successfully on HARD MODE
[*] You must post the video publicly on YouTube
[*] [b]You must send a link to the YouTube video to Info@funfreightergames.com with your desired mailing address.[/b]  If you would like us to share you on socials please include links to your tik tok, twitter, insta, or other preferred platform
[*] You must submit your play through by September 30th 2024
[*] You must live within the United States
[/list]

We are looking forward to watching your runs.  Good luck!

Overall UI improvements

notes.title: Melee Weapons and Abilities
notes.content:
Hi Sailors,

We are pushing a big update to the Scrap Seas demo.  Some of you may have had a chance to try out some of the new special abilities we've been testing at various conventions like MAGfest, Awesomecon, and Smash Con.  We are now pushing these to the Steam build!

First we have added 2 new special abilities

[h2]Submerge[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/dce25e4216f46b5b8fa267664b8f53eaeee1e708.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/02a2147d1216e7bd89b1b8c789ac2cb019b23d32.png[/img][/url]
Will allow your ship to dive underwater for a period of time where you will be immune to most attacks.  You will then rise back up to the surface and take your enemies by surprise!

[h2]Discharge[/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/63658826400a799b404c80c59bf2498ef0e954f2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/6ab95203e3b1125d5ec47719740ae6bc58c79bae.png[/img][/url]
Will emit a large field of lightning that will rapidly fill the paralysis meter of all the enemies around you.

[h2]Melee Weapons[/h2]
We also have new and unique skins for all the melee weapons in the game.

Spikes
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/b3db132b63d143236401b95b082a7b1abc90255d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/9376150a76eb6e5aaeda08e7ee3676a065b01c4b.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/808d91855d00e9e4cc79156be7ef01eac5ae8f25.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/fa79c26b6ec74026e1c0ffa71bca4d9cd598dfd2.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/905977c03d8fff577788c8435348f2708afab51c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/feba208e83f8293902c763b04fde3e0e6c384eb9.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/938283042973456190b4a6863eac61d3f97eac92.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/4e90861aa96f30b29883264f70ee4b6bb7ba3935.png[/img][/url]

Buzz Saws
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/cce11d7f01a5af2f3f0786fb07ee26049beae545.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/7da6c15344239eb9c4c7fd4c4190051d27f61595.png[/img][/url]  [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/01690cf48c8cc4858dfd35256aaf9bc390bc75c9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/8f8ffabb748c5ea96cd9a7673c1e15ee17c3ee28.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/954ef4ec338eaa7a4baf89030495bf49252bb71c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/224a0bcdfce26bc5ca5ca3f6a7c0182ec0a5ab80.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/a8beef9bbfbf3aa5bc1aeb881a05dd977b8600bd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/501928cf4130c5a39be6e16e340281e64a0affb9.png[/img][/url]

Electric Spikes
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/bb0211cceef74448ce6b4cddff70c8aa14dac1ca.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/4bf3000e8aac22f326f8539aeb43c7f32fe6b37a.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/fe3a6e4ba319797686e08ff623f6bd9d36a6cae8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/d35e0a518e80d0f517d1a12b32f61b3c1192622f.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/33263d9f2d1d17b8f80c0b3d4da0af06565fd72f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/bc244f5f01897684250a68bb53bc2bb83af2bb41.png[/img][/url]

There have also been several tweaks to UI and controls that should improve quality of life.

We plan on having another big update ready for this coming MAGfest in January.  In this update we hope to give you a taste of some of the role playing elements we plan to include for Scrap Seas!  So stay tuned to our mailing list and discord for the latest news!

notes.title: Scrap Seas Demo Patch V0.9.1
notes.content:
Hi Sailors!  We've got a very special update to SCRAP SEAS.
[previewyoutube=nBm8BbwjJCg;full][/previewyoutube]
The new Nova Ship is now available for you to pilot!  It also comes with a new captain, NED V1.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40999285/8430b86a6aed774bbf99ee7b4e9d3c26569c0c73.png[/img]
The ship can be unlocked by joining our community on the game over screen.  If you have already joined our mailing list, you should have received an e-mail explaining how to unlock it already.  If you have not received it check your spam folder.    

This ship comes with a new laser weapon.  Tapping will allow you to rapid fire laser shots.  Holding charge will allow you to fire a powerful laser that can push away enemy ships.  

If you want the cheat-codes we released so far, or any cheat-codes we release in the future.  Join our mailing list.  We send out new updates, including new cheat-codes, 1-3 times a month.

Mailing List: https://forms.gle/XEx1ZBYWUVohHmGNA

notes.title: Scrap Seas Demo Patch V0.8.1
notes.content:
Hi Sailors!  We've got yet another update to SCRAP SEAS.

The main highlight is that spikes can now be extended by hitting the "active melee" button.  That would be middle mouse button on keyboard and mouse or left bumper on controller.  Detailed explainer in this video.
[previewyoutube=Uf5TBWlyLKs;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

But basically after you ram another ship with spikes, you can extend the spikes to push them away.  This can be used to set up opportunities to hit them with other attacks or to push other ships into hazards.

[h3]
Other features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Game has comic book style freeze frame on level start
[*] WASD keys can now be rebound
[*] "Credits" now appear larger than other stats in the shop
[*] Bug fix to ship loadout customizer switching between keyboard and controller
[*] Halloween cheat code is now use-able
[/list]

[h3]Cheat Codes[/h3]
We just released the cheat-code to activate Halloween mode last week! 
[previewyoutube=OQKoCreBwa4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]  
If you want the cheat-codes we released so far, or any cheat-codes we release in the future.  Join our mailing list.  We send out new updates, including new cheat-codes, 1-3 times a month.

Mailing List: https://forms.gle/XEx1ZBYWUVohHmGNA

notes.title: Scrap Seas Demo Patch V0.7.0
notes.content:
Howdy Sailors! We have just released a new update!
[list]
[*] Loading times have been greatly reduced
[*] Screen shake is back in!  
[*] Sound will play now to indicate if you fail to shoot, boost, or use a special ability when said inputs are re-charging.
[*] Controls display has been added to HUD
[*] GUI updates on controller or keyboard use instantly
[*] Selection in shop will now be indicated with a glowing green outline
[*] b-button can now be used to exit menus
[*] controls menu now auto-scrolls 
[/list]

We still need your help to boost us in the Kickstarter algorithm! If you want to see Scrap Seas become a full game, be sure to sign up for our Kickstarter Pre-Launch Page here! https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/funfreighter/scrap-seas

We also hand out cheat codes through our mailing list!  Sign up to get the latest cheat codes! https://forms.gle/qm9SPUu4givMXVf88

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have pushed a minor update to the Scrap Seas demo. 

This update includes:

[list]
[*]     performance upgrades
[*]     bug-fixes to the pause menu​s
[*]     bug-fixes to back us on Kickstarter link
[/list]

If you tried to use the back us on Kickstarter link before and could not enter your e-mail address, please try again now it should work.  This will also allow you to join our Discord server!  We need as much support we can get if we are going to turn Scrap Seas into the full experience we know it can be!


Secret Stream
Also, we are participating in Steam Next Fest.  We have already done our two streams.  However, we will be doing a "SECRET STREAM" from 4pm to 8pmEST on tomorrow on Wednesday.   During the stream I will be trying out the unreleased "HARD MODE" for Scrap Seas.  Watch on our steam page and ask me anything you want.  I am the creative director for Scrap Seas.  I do the art/fx design and some of the scripting, I'd be happy to chat.


Follow us to get notified for the latest Scrap Seas news.  Including another major update with the aforementioned "HARD MODE!"

notes.title: Scrap Seas Demo Patch v0.1.1
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQJmDsDws4U
[b]Controller Support[/b]
[list]
[*] Scrap Seas now has full controller support.  Mouse should no longer be necessary for those who prefer a controller
[*] Boat now accelerates automatically for controller players
[*] Left trigger is now set to break/reverse by default
[*] Mouse and Controller Sensitivity Settings are now included in the settings menu
[/list]
[b]New Enemy Types[/b]
[list]
[*] Machine Gunners
[*] Mine Layers
[/list]
[b]Updates to Shop[/b]
[list]
[*] Purchasing equipment will now automatically take you to the ship customization menu
[*] New loading screens entering the shop will no longer wait for player confirmation.  Loading screens will also respond to any input now.
[/list]
[b]Difficulty Re-balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Difficulty budget per level has been tweaked
[/list]
